proof_quality_value: Accessibility checks, automated testing, and performance targets
about_preview_body: I plan and build full-stack web projects with maintainable structure, good performance, and reliable deployment.
contact_section_heading: Have a defined problem to solve?
contact_section_body: Share the scope, budget, and timeline. I usually reply within two business days.
services_page_intro: Choose a starting point based on what you need to launch. Prices and timelines are estimates; the final proposal reflects the scope, content, and integrations.
payment_terms: Pay 50% before work starts and 50% before launch or final source delivery.
revision_terms: Each project stage includes two rounds of combined feedback and revisions.
scope_terms: New features or changed requirements are quoted separately.
warranty_terms: I fix project defects reported within 30 days of launch.
services_cta_body: Share your goals, required pages or features, budget, and preferred launch date. I will suggest the closest starting point.
projects_page_intro: Selected sites and applications showing how I plan, build, test, and deploy different web projects.
contact_page_intro: Share enough detail to assess fit, scope, and timing. Files are not accepted; add relevant links to the summary.
form_summary_hint: Describe the goals, required features, current materials, and relevant links.
form_consent: I agree to the data use described in the privacy policy.
form_success: Your inquiry was sent. I will reply within two business days.
form_invalid_request: Some information is invalid. Review the form and try again.
form_verification_failed: Verification failed. Refresh the page and try again.
form_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
form_delivery_failed: The message could not be delivered. Email contact@mengche.dev instead.
privacy_intro: This policy explains how the site handles contact-form and analytics data.
privacy_form_body: The form collects the information you provide so I can assess and reply to your inquiry. Submissions arrive by email and are not stored in a site database.
privacy_processors_body: Cloudflare provides hosting, Turnstile checks, rate limits, email delivery, and privacy-focused analytics.
privacy_retention_body: Inquiry emails are deleted within 12 months of the last relevant contact unless an active contract, accounting rule, or legal duty requires longer retention.
privacy_rights_body: Email contact@mengche.dev to ask about, correct, or request deletion of inquiry information where applicable.
footer_rights: Personal content and project media are all rights reserved.
not_found_body: This page does not exist in the current site.
error_body: The page could not be loaded. Please return home and try again.
